summary: Configured node1's kernel to boot with audit=1 persistently via grubby, verified persistence across a live reboot, and confirmed the kernel audit subsystem is enabled post-restart.
actions_performed: Captured baseline boot_id, uptime, and current kernel cmdline on node1
Ran `sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"` to persistently add audit=1 to the default (and only) kernel entry
Verified grubby default args, /boot/loader/entries/*.conf, and /etc/kernel/cmdline all include audit=1
Rebooted node1 (sudo reboot) and polled until it came back online
Verified new boot_id and new uptime timestamp confirming an actual restart occurred
Verified /proc/cmdline post-reboot contains audit=1 and auditctl -s reports enabled 1
Reconfirmed grubby --info=DEFAULT still shows audit=1 after reboot, proving persistence

evidence.requirement: Kernel boots with audit=1 (pre-change baseline showing param was absent)
evidence.summary: Baseline: pre-change /proc/cmdline and grubby --info=DEFAULT had no audit=1; boot_id 739c9792-2418-47cc-a875-95b27428f3fc, boot time 2026-09-29 08:17:50

evidence.requirement: audit=1 persistently applied via grubby to all boot entries and /etc/kernel/cmdline
evidence.summary: grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" ran successfully; verification showed audit=1 in grubby --info=DEFAULT, /boot/loader/entries/*.conf (both normal and rescue), and /etc/kernel/cmdline

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, node1 restarted one at a time
evidence.summary: Reboot command issued via backgrounded setsid so ack returned immediately; next exec call timed out confirming node went down for restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id b3721708-41be-4eb1-89e0-f1c9588a7d77 differs from baseline 739c9792-2418-47cc-a875-95b27428f3fc, and uptime -s shows new boot time 08:18:43 vs prior 08:17:50

evidence.requirement: audit=1 setting persists across reboot and kernel audit subsystem is active
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1, auditctl -s reports 'enabled 1', and grubby --info=DEFAULT still shows audit=1 as the persistent default kernel args
